issues.description: F-CR-001 scripts/lib/workflow_continue.py:365 _advance_after_completed 调 _next_node 不分流 depends_on_explicit；DAG yaml 节点无 next 字段，首节点完成后 current_node=None → _finalize_if_topology_done 写 workflow_completed → DAG workflow 仅跑首节点即终止；critic not_rebutted（grep standard-8phase.yaml 无 next: 字段 + main() 调用链零 _select_next_dispatch_target 调用 + e2e 测试需手动 bootstrap 反向证据）
